# SLIS Jobline

> A comprehensive job board for library and information science careers hosted by Simmons University's School of Library and Information Science.

SLIS Jobline aggregates professional positions across academic libraries, health sciences libraries, archives, law libraries, and information science roles. The board features positions ranging from entry-level internships to leadership roles at major institutions like Dartmouth College, Texas Tech University, and the U.S. Court of International Trade.

- [Unit Assistant Director, Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center Libraries, (Amarillo, TX)](https://slis-jobline.simmons.edu/2026/03/18/unit-assistant-director-texas-tech-university-health-sciences-center-libraries-amarillo-tx): Unit Assistant Director position at Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center
- [Archivist, Boston Public Library, (Boston, MA)](https://slis-jobline.simmons.edu/2026/03/16/archivist-boston-public-library-boston-ma): Archivist position in Special Collections at Boston Public Library
